name: Vineyard
overview: The vineyard in Scripture is depicted as both a place of cultivation and a symbol of stewardship, as seen in the oversight of vineyards and their produce by appointed leaders like Shimei and Zabdi (1 Chronicles 27:27). It also reflects human responsibility and consequence, illustrated by the neglected vineyard overgrown with thorns and broken walls, symbolizing folly and slothfulness (Proverbs 24:30-31). The plain of the vineyards serves as a geographical marker in the context of victory and conquest (Judges 11:33), emphasizing its significance in the life and history of God's people.
